require(record_after.get("transaction_id") == record.get("transaction_id"),
            "paused switch record summary is not the retained record")
    require(record_after.get("outcome") == "completed",
            "paused switch record on disk is not completed")
evidence.reason: The on-disk retained record is checked only for transaction_id and outcome at 2541-2544. The completion-list and per-invocation checks at 2526-2532 apply to the stdout/summary record and the post-switch completion log, so a retained journal record with the same transaction ID and completed outcome but missing the two completions would still pass. The journal record should be checked for the same completion evidence, with the existing transaction-ID check tying it to stdout.
